settings.hit_rule: hit if the top-ranked process is any of the attack's target processes

aggregators.sum: hai_lib.localise (pre-registered E1 rule): sum of channel contributions per process
aggregators.mean: sum divided by the process's channel count

a_constant.note: the best constant process is chosen in-sample (optimistic)

leave_one_out.note: for each attack the set is re-optimised on the other attacks; the tie-averaged value averages over all optimal sets (random tie-break) and is the reported estimate; hits_first_optimum uses the lexicographically first optimum and is shown only to document its sensitivity to tie-breaking
